title: Direct and Indirect Speech: Miscellaneous Sentences — Quiz 146

## Direct and Indirect Speech: Miscellaneous Sentences

Practise reporting thanks, welcomes and remarks.

### Lesson focus

1. She said to me, “Thanks!”
2. The notice said, “Welcome to Punjab!”
3. She said to him, “Liar!”
4. She said to the boy, “Stupid!”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
